why_best: Coalescing critical messaging from subtle background noise creates an irresistible focal pull that elevates vital data points above routine interface elements.
why_bad: A standard hard cut or simple linear fade would render the high-value statement unremarkable, causing it to drown in the surrounding layout.
trap: A near-miss will linger too long in the chaotic mid-transition, sacrificing legibility for visual flair rather than snapping crisply into perfect clarity.
